about: A Zork-like underground empire. After a dream about a final test from a silver-haired old man, you wander dark passages, a junction with a stuck Elvish sword, a sunlit cliff oasis, and the shore of an underground ocean.

done.why: A few minutes of wandering gave me no puzzle, character or clear goal. It was only geography, so I quit.

moments.note: Moving south in the dark brought a grue warning. Turning on the lantern fixed it.
The sword is stuck in the rock and nothing hints at what to do about it.
The sunlit cliff oasis was a nice change of scene.

wished: A clear goal or something to do besides walk around
Some hint of what the final test is

lines.line: Seek me when you feel yourself worthy!
lines.why: The one hook in the opening, and nothing followed it up.

lines.line: A few seedlings from the world above, nurtured by the sunlight and occasional rains, have grown into giant trees

fun.why: I only walked from room to room and nothing paid off.

engagement.why: No hook strong enough to keep an impatient player.

difficulty.why: I hit no real obstacle in the time I played, apart from the stuck sword.

interestingness.why: The setting is evocative, but I didn't get far enough to see anything done with it.

prose.why: Solid, classic room descriptions. The cliff room stood out.
